name: Deti Bumazhnogo Polja
source:
A group of children finds themselves in a strange, isolated house, cared for by a woman known only as Mother. She's kind, but strict. Her one rule: never open the basement door. 

[From [url=https://akakyakakievich.itch.io/the-children-of-the-paper-field-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一群孩子发现自己身处一个陌生、孤立的房子里，由一位只被称为母亲的女人照顾。她很善良，但也很严格。她的一条规则是：永远不要打开地下室的门。

[来自[url=https://akakyakakievich.itch.io/the-children-of-the-paper-field-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
